monitor.title: System
monitor.subtitle: Live CPU, memory, disk, and GPU metrics

cleaner.title: Cleaner
cleaner.subtitle: One-click maintenance for everyday cleanup
cleaner.sectionBody: Run a focused cleanup without scanning first. Use Deep Cleaner to review items, or Memory Cleaner to free RAM.

tempPrefetchRecycle.title: Temp, Prefetch & Recycle Bin
tempPrefetchRecycle.body: Clear user temp folders, Prefetch when accessible, and empty the Recycle Bin.
tempPrefetchRecycle.confirm: Clean temporary files, Prefetch, and the Recycle Bin now?

diskCleanup.title: Full Disk Cleanup (Drive C)
diskCleanup.body: Launch Windows Disk Cleanup for drive C. Windows may ask for elevation.
diskCleanup.confirm: Launch Windows Disk Cleanup for drive C?

recycleOnly.title: Empty Recycle Bin
recycleOnly.body: Permanently remove items currently in the Recycle Bin.

freeMemory.title: Free Up Memory
freeMemory.body: Release standby RAM and report the measured free-memory change.
freeMemory.confirm: Optimize memory and report measured free RAM?

cleaner.cancelHint: Cancel stops as soon as the current step allows. Already deleted files stay deleted.

memoryCleaner.title: Memory Cleaner
memoryCleaner.subtitle: Optimize reclaimable RAM with live physical and virtual stats
memoryCleaner.areasBody: Choose which Windows memory lists to optimize. Standby and low-priority standby cannot both be on.
memoryCleaner.autoBody: Runs in the background while PC Toolkit Pro is open (including in the tray).
memoryCleaner.autoIntervalHint: Repeat optimization on a schedule from 5 minutes up to 24 hours.
memoryCleaner.autoThresholdHint: Optimize when free physical RAM drops below this level.
memoryCleaner.elevateBody: Some memory areas need administrator rights. Restart elevated for a full clean, or continue and skip those areas honestly.
memoryCleaner.confirm: Optimize the selected memory areas and report the measured free-RAM change?
memoryCleaner.cancelHint: Cancel stops before the next area starts.

outcome.skippedUnsupportedOs: Skipped — not supported on this Windows version

deepCleaner.title: Deep Cleaner
deepCleaner.subtitle: Scan first, then confirm what to remove
deepCleaner.tempFilesDetail: User temporary folders, Prefetch, and accessible system temp. Denied folders are skipped.
deepCleaner.recycleBinDetail: Empty the Recycle Bin for all drives.
deepCleaner.diskCleanupDetail: Launch Windows Disk Cleanup. Windows may ask for elevation.
deepCleaner.freeMemoryDetail: Optimize selected memory areas using the Memory Cleaner engine and report measured free RAM change.
deepCleaner.scanHint: Scanning only reads file information; cancel stops immediately. Administrator rights are not required.
deepCleaner.findBody: Scan temp, Prefetch, and reclaimable system junk. Review everything before you clean.
deepCleaner.empty: Run a scan to see reclaimable items

power.title: Power
power.subtitle: Immediate actions and scheduled shutdown
power.scheduleBody: Set a delay, then confirm. Cancel anytime before it runs.
power.activeBody: Windows will shut down when the timer reaches zero. You can cancel anytime.

information.title: Information
information.subtitle: Hardware and operating system details
information.psuUnavailable: Not reported by Windows (desktop PSU name is often unavailable)
information.unavailableTitle: Live hardware data needs the desktop app
information.unavailableBody: Browser preview (pnpm dev) cannot read CPU, GPU, or power details. Run pnpm tauri:dev or open a CI-built .exe to load real system information.
information.loadingHint: Hardware inventory can take a few seconds on some PCs.

history.title: Activity History
history.subtitle: Review cleanups, power actions, and their results
history.clearBody: This removes the activity log only. It does not undo cleanups, restore files, or change power settings.
history.emptyBody: Run Cleaner, Deep Cleaner, or a Power action and the results will show up here.
history.detailBody: Review what ran, what changed, and any notes from this activity.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Appearance, support, and about
settings.languageBody: Choose the language used by PC Toolkit Pro.
settings.themeBody: Use a light, dark, or system theme.
settings.dataFolderBody: Open the folder where settings, history, and local data are stored.
settings.activityHistoryBody: Review cleaner, memory, and power activity from this install.
settings.aboutBody: A lightweight Windows toolkit for cleanup, memory, monitoring, and power control.
settings.aboutDialogBody: Clean, monitor, optimize, and control your PC with a soft modern desktop shell.
settings.softwareUpdateBody: Check GitHub Releases for a newer signed build.
settings.noReleaseNotes: No release notes for this version.
